ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure there are four inputs W, X, Y, Z. The upper W and X are input to an AND gate marked &, and the output terminal of this gate has a small circle, indicating output inversion. The lower Y and Z are input to another AND gate marked &, and the output terminal of this gate also has a small circle, indicating output inversion. The two inverted branch signals enter the OR gate on the right marked ≥1, and the output terminal of this OR gate also has a small circle, with the final output being F. Reasoning: The upper AND gate first obtains WX, and the output-terminal bubble makes it become \overline{WX}. The lower AND gate first obtains YZ, and the output-terminal bubble makes it become \overline{YZ}. These two signals are added in the ≥1 OR gate, namely \overline{WX}+\overline{YZ}. The bubble at the output terminal of the final OR gate then inverts the entire OR result, therefore F=\overline{\overline{WX}+\overline{YZ}}.

raw_record.question_text: What is the Boolean output expression F of the logic circuit shown in the figure?

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit visually: inputs W and X feed an AND block with a bubble at its output, inputs Y and Z feed a second AND block with a bubble at its output, and the two resulting lines go into a ≥1 OR block that also has an output bubble before F. Translate the upper branch as \(\overline{WX}\) and the lower branch as \(\overline{YZ}\). Since these two branch signals are ORed and then inverted at the final gate, write \(F=\overline{\overline{WX}+\overline{YZ}}\).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧有四个输入 W、X、Y、Z。上方的 W 和 X 输入到一个标有 & 的 AND 门，该门输出端带有小圆圈，表示输出取反。下方的 Y 和 Z 输入到另一个标有 & 的 AND 门，该门输出端也带有小圆圈，表示输出取反。两个取反后的分支信号进入右侧标有 ≥1 的 OR 门，且该 OR 门输出端也带有小圆圈，最后输出为 F。推理：上方 AND 门先得到 WX，输出端气泡使其变为 \overline{WX}。下方 AND 门先得到 YZ，输出端气泡使其变为 \overline{YZ}。这两个信号在 ≥1 OR 门中相加，即 \overline{WX}+\overline{YZ}。最终 OR 门输出端的气泡再对整个 OR 结果取反，因此 F=\overline{\overline{WX}+\overline{YZ}}。
